none: PAS KENT-20C0C1: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, House of Constantine nummus or AE4. Obverse: Laureate bust right. Inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards reverse fields and exergue -//[]. Inscription: GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reece period 17. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Mint unidentifiable. The coin is in fine condition with some wear. It has a dark green patina but with some rusty brown staining, it is also corroded with some broken down edges and surface pitting. This coin is likely to date to 330-335AD. Ref.
